newsitem.title: USA: Plane makes emergency landing in California.
newsitem.headline: Plane makes emergency landing in California.

text.p: An American Airlines plane made an emergency landing at Sacramento International Airport Friday after one of its two engines lost power on takeoff, airport and airline officials said.
There were no injuries to the 136 passengers and five crew members on board, the airline said.

Flight 1842 was leaving Sacramento for Dallas when the right engine lost power during takeoff, John Hotard, a spokesman for American Airlines, said. "We suspect that the engine ingested some birds because there were some large birds in the area at the time," he said.

After the engine stalled, the pilot of the MD80 aircraft declared an emergency and landed safely back at the airport. The passengers were not in danger because the aircraft could have continued flying on one engine, officials said.
The plane was taken out of service and another was sent to pick up the passengers, an airport spokeswoman said.
